text: In Gambela, Ethiopia, nearly half of people still defecate in the open.
Half of residents live on a plain that floods. We start in Jikawo, Wantawo and Lare.
In 2022, floods displaced a hundred and eighty-five thousand people. Pits overflow, and waste reaches the wells.
Pits flood, crack in swelling clay and are never emptied, and nights are unsafe.
So we match the toilet to the ground: four designs, chosen from flood and soil data.
Local masons upgrade the latrine families have: lined walls, a raised slab, a vent, a lock and a solar light.
Green, yellow, red: no power needed. At red, seal the lid and use the pack.
FloodSafe Sanitation Gambella: a five-hundred-household pilot, and we're looking for partners.
